# @ndigo/view-ejs

Ndigo View EJS — server-side EJS template rendering as an isomorphic Ndigo view technology.

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `EJSIncludeCycleError` — Raised when EJS `include(...)` recursion exceeds the depth bound, or revisits a template already open in the current include chain (a cycle).
- `EJSTemplateEngineOptions` *(type)* — Options accepted by EJSTemplateEngine.
- `EJSTemplateEngine` — Renders EJS template strings to HTML using the `ejs` package.
- `EJSLocaleHelpers` *(type)* — Locale-aware template locals injected by EJSView.
- `EJSViewOptions` *(type)* — Construction options for EJSView.
- `EJSView` — A view that renders an EJS template into HTML.
- `EJSViewResolverOptions` *(type)* — Construction options for EJSViewResolver. Extends the shared view options with the path framing this resolver applies around each name.
- `EJSViewResolver` — Resolves logical view names to EJSView instances by applying a prefix and suffix around the name (e.g. `views/` + name + `.html`).
